Trump-Powell tension remains a background factor cited in tipranks coverage of collapsing cut odds.
commentary: Post July-CPI (2026-08-12), CME FedWatch shows Sep 2026 FOMC as a genuine toss-up between HOLD (~56%) and 25bp HIKE (~42%) — cuts are essentially off the near-term table with the target range at 3.50-3.75%. Market pricing implies a modestly hawkish path with terminal ~3.75-4.00% by year-end 2026 into Q1 2027; October/December/January per-meeting probabilities are directional estimates from aggregator commentary (I could not fetch CME primary page directly — WebFetch permission denied) so downweight tail probabilities beyond September.
